lines.text: [excited] Your context bloat is not mysterious, boss. It is measurable. And I measured it.
lines.caption: Your context bloat is not mysterious, boss. It is measurable. And I measured it.

lines.text: One task. Three loadouts. [curious] Same prompt every time, down to the byte. Same pass-fail test. Only the loadout changes.
lines.caption: One task. Three loadouts. Same prompt every time, down to the byte. Same pass-fail test. Only the loadout changes.

lines.text: Here is the task. A teammate proposes a side-border on a card. [curious] Does any skill you have actually name that as an anti-pattern it must refuse?
lines.caption: Here is the task. A teammate proposes a side-border on a card. Does any skill you have actually name that as an anti-pattern it must refuse?

lines.text: [mischievously] The answer is a term coined by exactly one skill contract. And it is not in the prompt. Guessing does not pass. Heh.
lines.caption: The answer is a term coined by exactly one skill contract. And it is not in the prompt. Guessing does not pass. Heh.

lines.text: One endpoint. Identical on all three arms. It is the task, not a per-arm goalpost. [mischievously] Nobody moves goalposts on my watch.
lines.caption: One endpoint. Identical on all three arms. It is the task, not a per-arm goalpost. Nobody moves goalposts on my watch.

lines.text: [curious] Arm one: native. Vanilla Claude Code, hauling this workstation's entire default loadout.
lines.caption: Arm one: native. Vanilla Claude Code, hauling this workstation's entire default loadout.

lines.text: One turn. One answer. NONE. It cannot name the thing.
lines.caption: One turn. One answer. NONE. It cannot name the thing.

lines.text: And it paid 46,490 per-turn tokens for a loadout that did not hold the one contract this task needed.
lines.caption: And it paid 46,490 per-turn tokens for a loadout that did not hold the one contract this task needed.

lines.text: It is not wrong, though. It answers correctly for what it has. I keep my claims narrow. They hit harder that way.
lines.caption: It is not wrong, though. It answers correctly for what it has. I keep my claims narrow. They hit harder that way.

lines.text: Arm two: the floor. [curious] Every door shut. Zero skills.
lines.caption: Arm two: the floor. Every door shut. Zero skills.

lines.text: The floor answers in a sentence, not the contract format. Same endpoint. Same failure.
lines.caption: The floor answers in a sentence, not the contract format. Same endpoint. Same failure.

lines.text: 30,601 tokens. [excited] And a verified negative. With no skills there is no term to name, so the model says so instead of inventing one. That is the good kind of failure.
lines.caption: 30,601 tokens. And a verified negative. With no skills there is no term to name, so the model says so instead of inventing one. That is the good kind of failure.

lines.text: [excited] Now subtract. 15,889 tokens of standing context. [mischievously] Both arms failed — one just paid 15,889 more to fail.
lines.caption: Now subtract. 15,889 tokens of standing context. Both arms failed — one just paid 15,889 more to fail.

lines.text: Tiny chaos detected. And it is not rhetoric — that is a subtraction between two live runs, gated identically.
lines.caption: Tiny chaos detected. And it is not rhetoric — that is a subtraction between two live runs, gated identically.

lines.text: [excited] Arm three: curated. One skill. The one that actually holds the contract.
lines.caption: Arm three: curated. One skill. The one that actually holds the contract.

lines.text: 227 tokens of standing listing. It opens that one contract, reads it, and answers.
lines.caption: 227 tokens of standing listing. It opens that one contract, reads it, and answers.

lines.text: [excited] FLAGGED: Side-stripe borders. The coined term, exactly as the contract writes it. Endpoint passes.
lines.caption: FLAGGED: Side-stripe borders. The coined term, exactly as the contract writes it. Endpoint passes.

lines.text: Its 55,924 per-turn includes the skill body being read during the run. That is work done, not weight carried. I will not fudge it for a prettier story.
lines.caption: Its 55,924 per-turn includes the skill body being read during the run. That is work done, not weight carried. I will not fudge it for a prettier story.

lines.text: Biggest loadout: failed. Smallest loadout: failed. [excited] The chosen one passed.
lines.caption: Biggest loadout: failed. Smallest loadout: failed. The chosen one passed.

lines.text: All three arms cost 13,940 milliseconds. [mischievously] The three minutes was me explaining.
lines.caption: All three arms cost 13,940 milliseconds. The three minutes was me explaining.

lines.text: Every figure here is read from the run transcript. The double-dagger marks the one pole measured but never committed. [excited] Now go pick your own loadout and make it undeniable. Your move, boss.
lines.caption: Every figure here is read from the run transcript. The double-dagger marks the one pole measured but never committed. Now go pick your own loadout and make it undeniable. Your move, boss.
